title: HHHusher reviews
description: Customer quotes on a camel band: a big two-line heading, then two reviews side by side, each a row of small yellow stars, a large medium-weight quote and the author in bold mono capitals. Reviews rise 40px and fade in as they enter; the heading rises line by line. Phones stack them.
notes: the band is the theme's secondary (tan)
name: hhhusher-reviews

props.name: title
props.description: the heading, one entry per line

props.name: reviews
props.description: two reviews side by side on desktop (more wrap into further rows)

props.name: ratingLabel
props.description: screen-reader text for each star row, e.g. "5 out of 5 stars"
